dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit thin, high-intensity perimeters with low-intensity centers. A prominent macro-annulus on the mid-ventral flank shows a highly crenulated edge geometry with a sharp gradient transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid, high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the anterior dorsal region (neck) and the posterior caudal region. These clusters lack internal gradient transitions and appear as isolated punctate marks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary set of four high-intensity blobs along the upper dorsal ridge forms a curved linear chain roughly parallel to the animal's spine.
